blocks.title: Physiotherapy
blocks.intro: Musculoskeletal, pelvic health, pregnancy and postnatal, and sports physiotherapy at Mos Lane, Mosman Park.

image.alt: Hands resting on a knee, black and white

blocks.text: Our physiotherapists look at the whole picture: how you move, how you live and what you want to get back to. Your first appointment runs for a full hour, so there is time to do that properly.

items.title: Musculoskeletal
items.body: Assessment and treatment for back, neck, shoulder, hip, knee and other joint and muscle concerns, including persistent pain.

items.title: Pelvic Health
items.body: Assessment and care for pelvic floor concerns, including bladder leakage, heaviness and pelvic pain, at any stage of life.

items.title: Pregnancy and Postnatal
items.body: Support through each trimester and the months after birth, including postnatal assessment and planning a return to exercise.

items.title: Sport
items.body: Injury assessment, rehabilitation and return-to-sport planning for recreational and club athletes.

left.alt: Hands resting on a knee, black and white

items.title: Assessment
items.body: A 60-minute initial consultation covering your history, how you move, and what matters to you day to day.

items.title: A plan you understand
items.body: You leave with a clear plan, including exercises and an explanation of what we found and why we are recommending each step.

items.title: Active care
items.body: Hands-on treatment where it is useful, with a focus on movement and exercise you can keep doing between appointments.

items.title: One team, one building
items.body: Where it suits your plan, you can move into clinical Pilates or reformer classes down the hall, with the same team keeping track.

blocks.label: Appointments
blocks.note: Private health rebates are available, depending on your fund and level of cover.
